# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest `main` branch is currently receiving security updates.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| `main`  | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within this project, please send an email to the repository maintainer rather than opening a public issue. We will review all security reports and aim to issue a response within 48 hours.
